summary: Wetour Robotics Ltd filed a Form 6-K with the SEC providing notice of an extraordinary general meeting (EGM) scheduled for August 4, 2026. The meeting agenda includes an authorized share capital increase from $100K to $20B (creating 1.99999 trillion new shares) and a share capital reorganization that reclassifies existing shares into Class A and Class B ordinary shares, with two large holders receiving Class B shares. No price, premium, or deal terms are stated. The filing is a routine notice and proxy statement for a shareholder vote on capital structure changes—not a special situation event, as it announces no acquisition, divestiture, or similar corporate action.
